title: The Dataflow Model: A Practical Approach to Balancing Correctness, Latency, and Cost in Massive-Scale, Unbounded, Out-of-Order Data Processing
author: Akidau et al. (VLDB 2015)
why: The paper that defined event-time windows, watermarks, triggers and accumulation modes; the source of the vocabulary every modern engine uses.

title: Streaming 101: The world beyond batch
author: Tyler Akidau (O'Reilly Radar)
why: The clearest introduction to bounded vs unbounded data and event time vs processing time; read Streaming 102 next for watermarks and triggers.

title: Apache Flink documentation: Timely Stream Processing, Windows and Checkpointing
author: The Apache Software Foundation
why: Primary reference for watermark strategies, idleness, allowed lateness, side outputs and checkpoint barriers.

title: Kafka Streams documentation
author: The Apache Software Foundation
why: How Kafka Streams handles stream time, grace periods, state stores with changelog topics and exactly_once_v2.
